articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Dual and Single Axis Solar Tracking System Considering Cloud Cover
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: The objective of this work is to carry out a comparative performance analysis of three types of solar tracking systems, fixed, single and dual axis, in the context of Bangladesh in order to determine their suitability and cost-effectiveness for different applications. Total incident solar energy on the photovoltaic panel of same size for the three different systems has been determined for the twelve months, first without and then with considering the effect of cloud cover. The findings show that there is no significant difference in energy yield between single axis and dual axis tracker. The percent difference in total incident energy in one whole year between the single and dual axis tracker systems is found to be about 3.96% without considering the effect of cloud which further reduces to 3.44% when the effect of cloud cover is taken into consideration.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Photovoltaic and Fuel Cell Based Micro-grid System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Energy is one of the primary needs for survival of all organisms in the universe. Energy has dependably been a noteworthy need for the everyday human life. For socio-economic advancement, the non-stop supply of adequate energy is vital. The instinctive assets are constrained and are being depleted at such a flustering rate, it is expected that the petroleum gas, which is the foremost energy source of Bangladesh, will be exhausted by the year 2031. To solve this problem, the micro-grid is one of the best solutions. This paper presents the design and simulation of a hybrid micro-grid system based on photovoltaic and fuel cell. The battery system is also incorporated in order to use the system in an emergency case. The performance of the system is evaluated at different loading conditions. Furthermore, on-grid stability of the system is tested by connecting it to the IEEE 13 bus system. Load flow analysis is done in order to ensure the power penetration from the proposed system to the grid. The design and simulation work is performed in the MATLAB/SIMULINK platform and found satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: Islanding detection and control of grid connected inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: In utility grid with different distributed power generation systems, unintentional islanding is a serious concern for the safety of personnel and various electrical and electronic equipment which are connected to the utility grid and it is necessary to detect islanding and isolate the equipment from the utility grid as soon as possible when there is power outage in the utility grid. In this paper, islanding is detected in 3-phase utility interactive solar powered distributed generator. Different passive islanding detection techniques have been verified with simulation results carried out with PSIM simulation software. Islanding detection operation has been verified with resistive, capacitive and inductive loads. Control of three-phase inverter synchronized with utility grid is also implemented.

articleTitle: Infrared Thermography Based Performance Analysis of Photovoltaic Modules
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Interest on generating power from photovoltaic (PV) system is increasing day by day. Power generation from such systems is affected by some factors that can be detected in early stage through proper monitoring. Infrared (IR) thermography is a well-known non-destructive technique which can detect localized heating and quantify hotspot area. In this study active thermography has been applied to detect possible anomalies based on the prediction of visual inspection data. Also temperature dependence on possible performance degradation have been analyzed. One of the main findings is that PV modules have some post manufacturing defects which is visually observable. Junction box creates heat that may impact on the module performance. Also difference between hotspot point temperature and the ambient temperature is found increase linearly with respect to module performance degradation.

articleTitle: Optimization and Management Strategy of Grid Connected Hybrid Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: This paper represents an optimization method as well as energy management strategy of grid connected renewable energy sources for multi house. Optimization method has been accomplished using HOMER software to bring out optimal size of renewable sources and other components for management strategy. The main purpose of this paper is to design an energy management strategy to optimize the cost and minimize the power loss of extracted power from renewable energy sources based on Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC). The system consists of PV array, AC wind generator, Battery, Converter and grid. FLC monitors load profile and delivers a signal to sources. Then FLC changes the switch for appropriate energy supply according to fuzzy rules. The management strategy is controlled by FLC in a way that extra power after meeting the energy demand of the house can be sold to the national grid which is more useful and cost feasible than any other conventional systems. The proposed management strategy is more effective than any other traditional systems which must minimize power loss.

articleTitle: Effect of Variation of Solar irradiance on the Inverter Output for a Grid connected PV system
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Solar radiation received on the surface of the earth varies continuously due to many factors like the appearance of paths of clouds, accumulation of water droplets and dust particles in a particular section in the atmosphere, changes of the density of air with temperature, humidity etc. The most prominent factor in affecting the output of the solar panel is due to the appearance of a cloud in a particular section of the earth's surface. In some seasons of the year, appearance and disappearance of the patches of clouds are so frequent that solar PV output and subsequently inverter output connected to the grid-tied system suffers large fluctuations in voltage and currents. In this paper, a simulation-based study has been made to assess the variation of inverter output with the variation of solar irradiation. Main findings of this paper are the average hourly irradiance effect on inverter output and irradiance effect on certain load. A solar PV module of 2×3 and an inverter have been chosen for the simulation study.

articleTitle: Millimeter Wave Based Sag Measurement Technique for Overhead Transmission Lines in Smart-Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: In smart-grid, power transmission monitoring and control is a key part. In a power system, power transmission capacity of a overhead transmission line is dependent on the sag of the line. Power transmission can be increased with the decrease in sag. Thus, real-time sag monitoring is required for effectively using the transmission lines for transferring power. In this paper, a simple, but yet effective millimeter wave (mmWave) based method for measurement of sag is proposed that only uses a single transmitter and a single transceiver. It is shown that based on the received power at the transceiver, sag can be calculated. Impact of different system parameters on the accuracy of the calculated sag is also investigated.

articleTitle: STATCOM and PID Controller Based Stability Enhancement of a Grid Connected Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Wind energy are drawing utmost importance in the research arena day by day as one of the renewable energy sources due to the limitation in conventional energy resources. But to stabilize the voltage harvested from wind energy has become a point of major concern. Different methodology are being adopted to mitigate this. In this study, grid-connected wind farm stability has been upgraded by mitigating voltage fluctuation and attaining reactive power compensation using Static Synchronous Compensator (STATCOM). Voltage control loop with PID controller has been used to control STATCOM. A Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) method has been adopted as the control strategy of STATCOM. Different comparative study regarding stabilization of a wind farm has been performed using different approach (i.e. wind farm with capacitor bank and STATCOM or using STATCOM along with Proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller) during wind speed change. Comparison of result shows that STATCOM with PID controller offers better performance with enhanced stability.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Solar Power System with Fuel Cell backup Source for Hybrid Power System Application
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: The demand for electrical power is increasing day by day throughout the world. In such a situation conventional sources of power may not meet the need. The importance of renewable power sources is considered as the alternative suitable energy sources nowadays. This paper deals with the simulation of the solar power system which is the main source and that has a fuel cell backup power source. Therefore, no charge storage device is interfaced. The proposed method has four major parts: solar cell as the main supply, fuel cell as a backup source, the control device for switching power from the main source to backup source and vice versa and the final part is a load. The load is energized by the solar energy directly through the control device. When the solar power is insufficient concerning the demand, then the load gets power from the fuel cell through the control device. However, if the solar power becomes sufficient to provide power to the load, the control device changes over the source from fuel to solar cell. The outcome of the simulation shows that the load always gets an uninterrupted power supply. The complete simulation has been accomplished using MATLAB Simulink environment (Math Works, Inc. USA).

articleTitle: An Optimized Stand-alone Green Hybrid Grid System for an Offshore Island, Saint Martin, Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Saint Martin's island is the largest offshore island of Bangladesh which is one of the most beautiful tourist spots in the world. But as the island is far away from the mainland, it is not connected to the main grid of the country. This paper proposes an optimized stand-alone green hybrid system to supply electricity for the inhabitants & tourists of the island. Considering 1000 households for all of its inhabitants and 200 hotel rooms for tourists, the average daily load is 1135.82 kWh/day with an annual peak load of 227.76 kW. The aim of this paper is to design the most cost efficient optimized standalone green hybrid system which provides zero emission and 100% renewable fraction. HOMER(Hybrid Optimization Model for Multiple Energy Resources) is used to design this system. The simulation results show that a hybrid system with 659 kW PV array, 3073 strings of batteries, 245 kW converter forms the most optimized stand-alone system with COE(Cost of Energy) of $0.266 and NPC(Net Present Cost) of $1379832. Significantly, energy cost of the proposed system is viable in context with socioeconomic condition of the country which will eventually provide the power solution maintaining the scenic beauty of the island.

articleTitle: Numerical Design and Analysis of Ocean Wave Energy Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Ocean energy is the utmost economically realistic solution for providing energy to the inshore areas. Wave energy generation by the simultaneous model of wave energy generator (WEG) and numerical analysis is being discussed. The concept of renewable energy is to convert various energy into electrical energy. Ocean wave energy is one of them which convert mechanical stress into electric energy. Installing WEG at inshore areas can be generated power, without consuming fuel and other resources. To analyze the mechanical system of WEG transform into the electrical circuit and enhance the accuracy and analysis method for wave energy. The floaters are forced to oscillate when ocean waves pass by, thus translator oscillates at the stator field converting the power of ocean waves into electrical energy.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Reactive Power Compensator Using STATCOM for ‘Muhuri Dam’ Wind Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Wind power has become the most paramount energy source amongst the green sources over the past few decades. The essential quandary that averts the integration of this energy into the grid is the voltage fluctuation and low stability of the wind turbine engenderers (WTG). These difficulties can be solved by utilizing contrivances commonly kenned as FACTS (Flexible Alternate Current Transmission Systems), more concretely the Static synchronous compensator (STATCOM), which uses the principle of reactive power injection or absorption into the system. In this paper we propose a study, over Muhuri Dam wind Farm (Bangladesh) about the amendment of its stability, Ride through fault capability and minimization of voltage fluctuation utilizing STATCOM. The STATCOM used is IGBT predicated PWM Cascade inverter that employs an early control system which gives some extra advances over the conventional STATCOMs.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation of Poly Si and Mono Si PV Modules: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: This work investigates the performance of commercially available poly and mono Si photovoltaic (PV) modules under different temperature and illumination conditions. While mono Si module shows better solar cell features in terms of series resistance, reverse saturation current and fill factor, the photo generated current and output power of mono Si module are found to be much lower than those obtained with poly Si module. Lower photo-generated current in mono Si module is attributed to higher recombination in thick bulk layer of mono Si cell, which is probably due to the lower than required crystal grade of mono Si module. The findings of this work suggest the need for better regulation for quality control of commercially available PV modules.

articleTitle: Developing a Voltage Control Methodology for Renewable Integrated Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: This paper proposes a methodology for voltage control in renewable integrated microgrids. The problems in voltage that occur for microgrids operating in islanded mode are discussed and measures to solve the problems have been proposed using Battery Energy Storage System(BESS) and STATCOM(STATic synchronous COMpensator) integrated test bus. Different case studies were introduced in the test system that analyzed intermittency in voltage without any compensator, with BESS and with STATCOM. Varying active and reactive power supplied by these storage devices the variations in voltage change were studied. Root Mean Square Errors were calculated for each case and these values were compared to check for the system with the least error with respect to normalized voltage value in per unit system.

articleTitle: Study and Analysis of Switching Transients in High Voltage Transmission Line from Barapukuria to Bibiyana of Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Energizing or de-energizing of a transmission line creates switching-transients that travel along the line following switching. The switching transient over-voltage will reach its highest levels at the transition points connecting an underground cable to an overhead line. The transient over-voltage exceeds the nominal voltage of the system and get transmitted to the lower voltage levels. The magnitude of the transient over-voltage has to be limited to avoid exceeding substation equipment surge ratings. Without such limits, the overvoltage may cause damage to the system protective devices. This paper reports a study on transient over-voltages associated with closing a breaker to energize 400 kV single circuit and 400-230 kV double circuit from Barapukuria to Bibiyana high voltage transmission line in the Bangladesh power system. PSCAD simulation tool has been used for this analysis. The main objective of this study is to find the main reasons for the switching transients and to provide some recommendations to minimize the switching transient's overvoltage.

articleTitle: Study and Analysis of the Performance of Grid-Connected Multi-PMBLDC Motor Drive System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: This paper aims at evaluating the performance of multiple Permanent Magnet Brushless Direct Current (PMBLDC) motor drive connected to common DC bus system, when subjected to different types of fault (shunt faults) in DC side of the considered system. The DC bus is further considered to be connected to AC grid. Impact of faults on the dynamics of the variables in both DC side and AC side are observed and analysed. In order to perform such analysis PMBLDC motor is modelled in such a manner that inter-turn fault can be created in the modelled motor. The study is carried out in PSCAD/EMTDC platform.

articleTitle: PHEV Participating in Load Frequency Regulation of Interconnected Smart Grid Using Integral Linear Quadratic Gaussian Control Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: This paper proposes the high efficient integral linear quadratic gaussian (ILQG) controller design for frequency stabilization of two area tie-in smart grid (SG). In SG, the main challenge is to keep the frequency fluctuation in a acceptable range. The aim of designing the proposed control framework is to stabilize the frequency fluctuation populated with PHEV. The controller is an improved version of linear quadratic gaussian (LQG) with an integral action. The PHEV has been developed as an environmental friendly vehicle. It is normally installed in consumer side. The proposed control method is evaluated by using two area interconnected model. The proposed controller is simulated on MATLAB to measure the effectiveness of the controller. The results ensure that the introduced controller achieves robust performance for frequency stabilization of smart grid.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Solar Tracking Systems for Submersible Centrifugal Fuel Pump
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Solar tracking system is a paramount component for utilizing the full potential of the solar system. Single axis and dual axis tracking system are available to be used with a solar panel. Both of them along with a fixed tilt system was implemented and evaluated based on their performance. The load was selected to be a DC submersible centrifugal fuel pump commonly used for fuel refilling purpose. The impeller of the fuel pump was modified for better results. For the fixed-tilt system, maximum power achieved at no load condition was 18.83 W and at full load it reached 12.9 W. For single axis tracking system, no load condition wielded 27.48 W and full load condition wielded 15.36 W. The dual axis tracking system leads to a maximum power of 27.72 W and 15.5 W for no load and full load condition respectively. The 12 V DC pump was able to pump 11 liters of petrol per minute for the dual-axis tracking system.

articleTitle: A Possible Alternative Power Solution of Base Stations in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: This paper presents the comparative cost analysis of different renewable energy sources along with traditional diesel generator for base transceiver stations. Base transceiver stations are the equipment in the cellular system which need to run 24/7 without being disturbed by any sort power outages. It is found that all the operators in Bangladesh use diesel generators during power outage. The target is to compare the feasibility of using alternative power sources to minimize the cost of the system, minimizing carbon emission and reducing the dependency on the fossil fuel. In this paper, the previous and recent data of diesel, solar and fuel cell power sources are analyzed. Finally, a new model is proposed to combine the sources with backup of diesel generator which can minimize the cost and fulfill the target.

articleTitle: A case study to Install Rooftop Solar Photovoltaic in Cote D'Azur, France
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Solar PV can be undoubtedly a good source of green energy if we don't consider only the price rather than think about the impact on the environment. Rooftop solar PV installation can be a good alternative to minimize the use of fossil fuel based power consumption. While calculating solar PV, several factors (eg. rooftop tilt angle, corrective features, performance ratio, solar panel efficiency e.t.c.) need to be considered while calculating available surface area. By using these factors, the generalized method of annual energy production from time series global horizontal irradiation value is briefly described in section three. That's how a case study is made on the available rooftop area in Cote D'Azur region in France and probable energy production is counted based on it.

articleTitle: Analytical Study Of Impact Of Prepaid Metering System In Power Distribution Sector In Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Prepaid meter is one of the new improvement in the billing system of the power system of Bangladesh. Traditional metering system has its own drawbacks(like overbilling, under billing, bill missing, high account receivable/sales, and easy meter tempering). These drawbacks lead the installation of a new metering system over the world. In Bangladesh installation of the prepaid meter is started in 2005 and people of this country have started getting benefits of using the prepaid meter. This paper is mainly focused on the technical as well as the commercial effect of a prepaid meter in the distribution system. It has been found that prepaid meter system increased revenue collection, reduced system loss and increased system reliability.

articleTitle: Development of Network Friendly Charging Methodology for Plugged in Hybrid Electric Vehicle(PHEV) in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: The introduction of electric vehicles has added a new dimension in modern transport system. Replacing the fossil-fuel based traditional vehicles and electrification of vehicles with the integration of improved smart electric grid assists to acquire an eco-friendly, unadulterated and livable global environment. Plugged in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) can be defined as a type of electric vehicle whose battery is recharged by plugging it to a charging station. For the proper utilization, it is necessary to handle the technical issues by an effective approach which was the actual purpose behind working on this paper. It is notable from the findings that there is a reduction in the grid loss amount while operating grid to vehicle (G2V) and vehicle to grid (V2G) systems simultaneously, it's also a challenging task for future to find out an appropriate algorithm for operating both G2V and V2G in the same bus at a time.

articleTitle: Development of MATLAB simulink model of Invelox to Analyze The Impact of Inlet Height On speed ratio
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Diverse models of wind turbines are established by various researchers. Each model has its own advantage and disadvantage. One of the major problems associated with the traditional and other ducted wind turbine is the massive height and the rotating turbines which makes it difficult for maintenance. Also such wind turbines causes various environmental hazards. So a unique design of wind turbine is required to provide sustainable, high performance, affordable and cost effective electrical energy to anywhere and anyone. INVELOX is a new innovation in the wind power industry that has unique structure and has claimed to solve all the major issues associated with the current wind turbines. In this paper, MATLAB/simulink model of INVELOX is developed to determine speed ratio based on inlet height. Simulation of the development process is based on the concept of continuity principle. Analysis indicates that the proposed model is satisfactorily accurate to determine the speed ratio (SR) of the INVELOX.

articleTitle: A Real Time Electrical Load Distribution Monitoring and Controlling System Based on PLC and Webserver
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: As global energy demand is constantly on the rise; power management has been becoming a major issue in the past decades or so due to less energy reserves. Power shutdown is a key crisis at the present time whereas disruption of power can cause a huge production loss for industries which calls for proper power management and monitoring in a systematic way. This paper deals with this issue by developing a prototype system and implementing real time energy monitoring and controlling of the system. In this system, power from main line is distributed and supplied to certain loads. If capacity of distributed load is less than required, then another line will be activated in parallel in order to prevent power shutdown and avoid production losses. Moreover, this process can ensure safety by tripping the system in case of any fault occurrence. All these are performed in an automated process using PLC and Web server.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Different Parameters of Bryophillum Pinnatum Fuel cell for Improving Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: The pH level of Bryophillum Pinnatum leaves (BPL) is 4.25, which is a suitable amount of acid for generating electricity. When the mixture of water and the acidic juice of Bryophillum Pinnatum comes to contact with Zinc and Copper plates, forming an organic cell which generates a small amount of voltage. In this paper, improved efficiency can be observed by changing the gap between the electrodes and the mixture procedure. The surprising fact is that, after using the cell for a week, the output voltage level continues to decline. It can be improved again by reusing the previous BPL fiber and juice. This well-developed cell shows more efficiency than previous works. A cheap battery can be developed with a combination of this type of cells. Using this technology it is possible to provide electricity to the isolated community like Bandarban, Sandip of Bangladesh where free space is available for cultivating this plant. So, in this paper, electricity generation is not only the main concern but to develop a more efficient cell with maximum utilization of natural leaves. This environment-friendly, cheap and easy way will be a good solution for the isolated community.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of a Green and Non-Concentrated Solar Thermoelectric Generator System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: The thermoelectric generator (TEG) is made of two dissimilar materials whose one material has negative temperature coefficient and rest one has positive temperature coefficient. TEG produces electrical energy from thermal energy base on Peltier-Seebeck effect. In this paper, the TEC1-12706 TEG modules used to construct a module array for solar thermoelectric generator (STEG) system. After that the performance of STEG was evaluate under sunshine over a day. During performance evaluation, the hotter surface of the STEG array was put under sunshine with the attachment of solar irradiance absorber plate (pitch painted aluminium sheet) and cold surface connected with heat sink which was keep in mud made vessel water. The STEG system is showing maximum open circuit voltage, short circuit current at the temperature difference between the junctions 15°C and 9°C respectively.

articleTitle: Prospects of Solar Home System in Bangladesh: Feasibility & Constraints Analysis at Char Paschim Tepakhola in Faridpur
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: At present power crisis is one of the most exigent problems and it becomes tremendously intolerable at rural area in Bangladesh. Generally, rural areas are located far away from power distribution side, but some rural areas at costal and hill track region is more challenging, hazardous and expensive issue to supply grid power. In this case, solar home system (SHS) can be a perfect solution to energize in those rural areas. Conventional energy sources are not only limited but also liable for environment pollutions. On the contrary, Solar energy is eco-friendly and available in everywhere. Being a tropical country Bangladesh is remarkable for solar radiation. It is good news for SHS, Bangladesh Govt. takes some important steps to encourage people using solar system in rural area of Bangladesh. IDCOL is a Bangladeshi government owned nonbanking financial institute that financed installation more than 3 million Solar Home System (SHS) in rural area in August, 2014. There are some drawbacks in solar system that are high installation cost and short back up time. This paper focuses about the prospects and constraints of SHS in rural areas.

articleTitle: A Survey on Coal Gasification Scenarios in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Coal gasification technology is an emerging technology to extract coal energy for using in many purposes including chemical production, thermal process and electrical power generation. This is comparatively a new technology for Bangladesh because of lack of financial investment, technical knowledge, support, experts and practical experiences. According to power system master plan (PSMP) of Government of Bangladesh, coal will get the highest priority as primary source of power generation. To generate clean electricity from coal, gasification is the highly efficient and environment friendly technology. Therefore, coal gasification technology has huge prospects in Bangladesh. This paper surveys the coal gasification scenarios in Bangladesh and presents the gasification technology adopted by different industries mentioning their present condition. In addition, coal gasification technology and the potential application of this technology in Bangladesh is discussed.

articleTitle: Artificial Light's Effects on Solar Cell's Short Circuit Current (ISC) and Open Circuit Voltage (VOC): A Simulation-Based Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Solar cell is a light-dependent cell that works under normal sunlight. Nowadays, PV is being used under indoor light environment. Indoor light is an abundant source for such light dependent applications and the efficiency of the absorption process of light play an important role in the performance of the solar cell. So, light intensity and temperature have a great effect on the performance of the solar cell. This article presents the artificial light effects on the open circuit voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</sub>) and short-circuit current (I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</sub>) of the solar cell using PSpice Software. Inputs of a solar cell are generally the value of the spectral irradiance, the wavelength of light source, absorption coefficient, reflection coefficient etc. These can be easily implemented in PSpice using pulse source, piecewise linear (PWL) source, E-device (voltage controlled voltage source) etc.

articleTitle: Analysis of Measured Current Densities and Power Densities Obtained From a Microbial Fuel Cell Using Saltbridge as Membrane
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: This research paper analyzes the performance of Microbial Fuel Cell (MFC) for different sludges (drain sludge, tannery sludge and Turag sludge). Saltbridge was used here as proton exchange membrane whereas starch of boiled rice was utilized as a source of carbohydrates for the growth of the microorganism. Water was placed in the cathode chamber as the electron acceptor. A total number of three experiments were carried out throughout the research and all of them were inspected for seven days under aerobic condition. A fixed amount of sludge (1 L), substrate (1 L) and water (2 L) were used. Analysis of the MFCs constructed during this research work is based on the measured current density and power density from each experiment across different loads. In this study 359.6 mV was measured as the highest voltage across while 13.07 mA/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 4.7 mW/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> were recorded as maximum current density and power density respectively for Turag sludge.

articleTitle: Smart Meter with Load Prediction Feature for Residential Customers in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Energy and Power Engineering (ICEPE)
abstract: Conventional energy meter needs to be monitored physically to make the monthly bill. In substitute of the conventional method, a prepaid meter is installed to calculate the amount of the power consumption and the bill is paid earlier by input a series of digits with the help of meter Dialpad. To know the quantity of the used power, the customer requires to check the energy meter manually through dialing some predefined code. This research paper demonstrates a load forecasting based smart energy meter offering an accurate calculation of the used power and cost, reducing the labor cost, efficient and cost-effective. A microcontroller is engaged in calculating the current, voltage, energy and cost while a GSM module for informing the customers and power distributors about daily power use as well as monthly billing by the SMS system. To illustrate the real-time current, voltage and energy for customer notification a 16×2 Liquid Crystal Display is utilized. An immaculate multimeter that is superbly lined up with the wattmeter is utilized to calculate the current and voltage. To adjust the proposed wattmeter, a variable rheostat has been used where its outcome is nonlinearly contrasted with a conventional wattmeter and obtained the accuracy is about 98%. In addition, forecasting of the following day power consumption makes the proposed framework more exceptional. In consequence of this feature, the system will assist the customer to be economical in power consumption and the amount of power wastage will be diminished drastically. The proposed method is perfect in billing procedure, informing and forecasting the power consumption and enhances the customer satisfaction level.
